AddHiveEdgeWorkers.description_zh: 将一个或多个负载实例绑定到指定的集群中

AssociateRenderingProjectInstances.description_zh: 云应用服务实例与项目进行关联

BatchBindDirectories.description_en: Binds multiple devices to directories in a single operation
BatchBindDirectories.description_zh: 批量绑定多个设备到目录

BatchBindParentPlatformDevices.description_en: Binds multiple devices to a parent platform for push in batches
BatchBindParentPlatformDevices.description_zh: 批量绑定多个设备到上级平台推送

BatchBindTemplate.description_en: Bind templates to multiple specified instances, such as instances bound to spaces and streams
BatchBindTemplate.description_zh: 绑定模板到指定的多个实例，比如：绑定到空间和流的实例

BatchBindTemplates.description_en: Binds multiple templates in a single operation

BatchCaptureRenderingInstanceScreenshot.description_en: Retrieves screenshots of cloud application service instances
BatchCaptureRenderingInstanceScreenshot.description_zh: 用于获取云应用服务实例的屏幕截图

BatchDeleteDevices.description_en: Deletes multiple devices in a single operation

BatchDeleteVsDomainConfigs.description_en: Deletes domain name configurations in a batch

BatchForbidVsStream.description_en: Stop stream ingest for one or more streams. You can schedule when to resume ingest
BatchForbidVsStream.description_zh: 禁止某条流的推送，可以预设某个时刻将流恢复

BatchResumeVsStream.description_en: Resumes stream ingest for one or more streams

BatchSetVsDomainConfigs.description_en: Configure multiple domain names in batch

BatchStartDevices.description_en: Start stream pulling for multiple devices at once

BatchStopDevices.description_en: Stops stream pulling for multiple devices

BatchStopStreams.description_en: Stops multiple streams in a batch

BatchUnbindDirectories.description_en: Detaches multiple devices from a folder in bulk
BatchUnbindDirectories.description_zh: 从目录内批量解绑多个设备

BatchUnbindParentPlatformDevices.description_en: Batch unbind multiple devices from parent platform push
BatchUnbindParentPlatformDevices.description_zh: 从上级平台推送中批量解绑多个设备

BatchUnbindPurchasedDevices.description_en: Detach multiple purchased devices from a space in a single operation
BatchUnbindPurchasedDevices.description_zh: 从空间批量解绑多个已购设备

BatchUnbindTemplate.description_en: Detach a template from multiple specified instances, such as space instances or stream instances
BatchUnbindTemplate.description_zh: 解除绑定模板到指定的多个实例，比如：解除绑定到空间和流的实例

BindDirectory.description_en: Attach a device to a folder

BindParentPlatformDevice.description_en: Binds a device to push streams to a parent platform
BindParentPlatformDevice.description_zh: 绑定设备到上级平台推送

BindPurchasedDevice.description_en: Attach purchased devices to a space
BindPurchasedDevice.description_zh: 绑定已购买设备至空间

BindTemplate.description_en: Binds a template to a specified instance, such as a group or stream
BindTemplate.description_zh: 绑定模板到指定的实例，比如：绑定到空间和流的实例

ContinuousAdjust.description_en: Continuously adjust lens parameters such as aperture and zoom
ContinuousAdjust.description_zh: 持续调节镜头，如光圈、变焦等

ContinuousMove.description_en: Rotate the camera continuously by panning, tilting, or zooming
ContinuousMove.description_zh: 持续转动镜头，如水平、垂直、缩放等

CreateComfyUserDataDir.description_en: Creates a directory for user data
CreateComfyUserDataDir.description_zh: 创建一个用户数据的目录

CreateRenderingDataPackage.description_en: Creates a data pack for a cloud application service
CreateRenderingDataPackage.description_zh: 创建云应用服务数据包

CreateRenderingInstance.description_en: Call CreateRenderingInstance to create a cloud application service instance
CreateRenderingInstance.description_zh: 调用CreateRenderingInstance创建一个云应用服务实例

CreateRenderingProject.description_en: Creates a cloud application service project and configures its properties, such as session attributes
CreateRenderingProject.description_zh: 创建一个新的云应用服务项目，并设置会话等相关属性

CreateStreamSnapshot.description_en: Creates an on-demand snapshot for the specified stream
CreateStreamSnapshot.description_zh: 对指定流，按需创建新的截图

DelHiveEdgeWorkers.description_en: Unbinds one or more workload instances from a specified cluster
DelHiveEdgeWorkers.description_zh: 用于从指定集群中解绑一个或多个负载实例

DeleteCloudApp.description_en: Deletes a cloud application. You cannot delete a cloud application that is in use
DeleteCloudApp.description_zh: 删除一个云应用。使用中的云应用不允许删除

DeleteComfyUserData.description_en: Deletes a file or directory from user data
DeleteComfyUserData.description_zh: 删除用户数据的中的文件或目录

DeleteDevice.description_en: Deletes a device from a space

DeleteFile.description_en: You cannot delete a file while it is uploading or pre-pushing. After deletion, all related push records become invalid. You can push a file with the same name again
DeleteFile.description_zh:
删除一个文件对象。
文件在上传/预推中时，不允许删除。文件删除后，所有相关的推送记录将失效，可重新推送同名文件

DeleteHive.description_en: Deletes an empty cluster by the specified ID
DeleteHive.description_zh: 根据指定ID删除一个空的集群

DeletePublicKey.description_en: Deletes a specified public key. This action automatically revokes logon authorization for all associated cloud application service instances
DeletePublicKey.description_zh: 删除一个指定公钥。该公钥关联的所有云应用服务实例将自动失效登录授权

DeleteRenderingInstanceConfiguration.description_en: Deletes the configuration of a cloud application service instance. This operation deletes only module properties that are configured using the UpdateRenderingInstanceConfiguration operation
DeleteRenderingInstanceConfiguration.description_zh: 清除一个云应用服务实例的配置设置。仅可删除通过UpdateRenderingInstanceConfiguration接口已配置的模块属性

DeleteRenderingInstanceSettings.description_en: You can call DeleteRenderingInstanceSettings to delete the settings of a cloud application service instance
DeleteRenderingInstanceSettings.description_zh: 调用 DeleteRenderingInstanceSettings 删除云应用服务实例设置

DeleteRenderingProject.description_en: Delete a Data Service Project. Projects that have business scheduling data, such as active sessions, cannot be deleted
DeleteRenderingProject.description_zh: 删除一个云应用服务项目，有在线会话等业务调度数据的项目不允许删除

DeleteVsStreamsNotifyUrlConfig.description_en: Deletes the callback configuration for stream ingest

DescribeAccountStat.description_en: Query all resource information for an account in a specified region
DescribeAccountStat.description_zh: 查询某个账号在指定地域下的所有资源信息

DescribeComfyProductionDownloadUrl.description_en: Retrieves a download link for a production
DescribeComfyProductionDownloadUrl.description_zh: 获取用户生成结果的下载链接

DescribeComfyTasks.description_en: Queries the list of Comfy tasks

DescribeComfyUserDataDownloadUrl.description_en: Gets a download URL for user data

DescribeComfyUserDataUploadUrl.description_en: Retrieves a URL to upload a user file
DescribeComfyUserDataUploadUrl.description_zh: 获取用户文件上传URL，使用该URL进行文件上传

DescribeComfyUserDatas.description_en: Lists all files and folders in the user data
DescribeComfyUserDatas.description_zh: 列举用户数据的中所有文件和目录的信息

DescribeComfyWorkflows.description_en: This operation retrieves a paginated list of your Comfy workflows
DescribeComfyWorkflows.description_zh: 查询所有Comfy工作流信息，支持分页查询

DescribeDeviceChannels.description_en: Queries a list of device channels

DescribeDeviceURL.description_en: Queries the URL information for a device stream

DescribeGroups.description_en: You can query the list of spaces

DescribeParentPlatform.description_en: Queries information about a parent platform

DescribeParentPlatformDevices.description_en: Queries the list of devices under a parent platform
DescribeParentPlatformDevices.description_zh: 查询上级平台下的设备列表

DescribeParentPlatforms.description_en: Query the list of parent platforms

DescribePurchasedDevices.description_en: Queries the list of purchased devices

DescribeRenderingInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a cloud application service instance
DescribeRenderingInstance.description_zh: 查询一个云应用服务实例的详细信息

DescribeRenderingInstanceConfiguration.description_en: Queries the real-time configuration of a cloud application service instance
DescribeRenderingInstanceConfiguration.description_zh: 查询一个云应用服务实例系统配置的实时信息

DescribeRenderingInstanceSettings.description_en: DescribeRenderingInstanceSettings queries the configuration of a Cloud Application service instance
DescribeRenderingInstanceSettings.description_zh: 调用 DescribeRenderingInstanceSettings 查询云应用服务实例配置

DescribeRenderingSession.description_en: Retrieve details about a rendering session, including the current session state, network access IP address and port, and the location of the cloud application service instance
DescribeRenderingSession.description_zh: 查询会话的详情信息，包含会话当前状态、网络访问IP/端口、云应用服务实例位置等信息

DescribeStreamURL.description_en: Retrieves the URL of a stream

DescribeStreamVodList.description_en: Get the stream VOD record list, such as historical stream list from NVR
DescribeStreamVodList.description_zh: 获取流点播记录列表，例如来自NVR的历史流列表

DescribeStreams.description_en: Lists video streams. You can filter the results by stream ID, name, group ID, device ID, or other criteria
DescribeStreams.description_zh: 查询流的列表信息，支持通过流的ID，名称，空间ID，设备ID等过滤筛选

DescribeVodStreamURL.description_en: Retrieves the URL information of a video-on-demand (VOD) stream

DescribeVsCertificateList.description_en: Retrieves a list of domain name certificates
DescribeVsCertificateList.description_zh: 获取域名证书列表信息

DescribeVsDevicesData.description_en: Retrieves usage data for connected devices
DescribeVsDevicesData.description_zh: 获取接入设备用量数据

DescribeVsDomainBpsData.description_en: Queries network bandwidth monitoring data for Domain Names
DescribeVsDomainBpsData.description_zh: 查询域名网络带宽监控数据

DescribeVsDomainCertificateInfo.description_en: Retrieves the certificate information for a specified accelerated domain name
DescribeVsDomainCertificateInfo.description_zh: 获取指定加速域名证书信息

DescribeVsDomainConfigs.description_en: Queries domain name configurations. You can query the configurations of multiple features in a single request
DescribeVsDomainConfigs.description_zh: 查询域名配置，一次可查询多个功能配置

DescribeVsDomainDetail.description_en: Obtains the basic configuration information for a specified Visual Edge Computing Service domain name
DescribeVsDomainDetail.description_zh: 获取指定视图计算域名配置的基本信息

DescribeVsDomainPvData.description_en: Queries the page view (PV) data for a domain name

DescribeVsDomainPvUvData.description_en: Retrieve page view (PV) and unique visitor (UV) data for a Visual Edge Computing Service domain

DescribeVsDomainRecordData.description_zh: 获取 vs 域名记录数据

DescribeVsDomainReqBpsData.description_en: Query network request monitoring data for a domain name
DescribeVsDomainReqBpsData.description_zh: 获取域名网络请求监控数据

DescribeVsDomainReqTrafficData.description_en: Obtain traffic data for domain name requests
DescribeVsDomainReqTrafficData.description_zh: 获取 vs 域名请求流量数据

DescribeVsDomainSnapshotData.description_en: Retrieves snapshot data for a domain name

DescribeVsDomainTrafficData.description_en: Retrieve traffic data for a domain name

DescribeVsDomainUvData.description_en: Retrieve UV data by domain name
DescribeVsDomainUvData.description_zh: 获取 vs 域名 uv 数据

DescribeVsPullStreamInfoConfig.description_en: Queries the pull stream configurations for a domain name
DescribeVsPullStreamInfoConfig.description_zh: 查询域名下拉流配置信息

DescribeVsStreamsNotifyUrlConfig.description_en: Queries the stream ingest callback configuration

DescribeVsStreamsOnlineList.description_en: Retrieves information about all active streams for a specified domain name or application
DescribeVsStreamsOnlineList.description_zh: 查看指定域名下（或者指定域名下某个应用）的所有正在推的流的信息

DescribeVsStreamsPublishList.description_en: Retrieve stream ingest records for a domain, an application under that domain, or a specific stream within a specified time range
DescribeVsStreamsPublishList.description_zh: 获取某一时间段内某个域名（或域名下某应用或某个流）的推流记录

DescribeVsTopDomainsByFlow.description_en:
Retrieves a user's domain names ranked by traffic.
If you do not specify StartTime and EndTime, data for the current month is retrieved by default. To query data over a specific time range, you must specify both StartTime and EndTime.
* You can retrieve data for a maximum of 90 days
DescribeVsTopDomainsByFlow.description_zh:
获取用户按流量排名的域名

不指定StartTime和EndTime时，默认读取当月的数据，同时支持按指定的起止时间查询，两者需要同时指定。

最多可获取90天的数据

DescribeVsUpPeakPublishStreamData.description_en: Queries the daily peak number of concurrent stream ingest operations
DescribeVsUpPeakPublishStreamData.description_zh: 查询用户的每日上行并发推流数峰值

DisassociateRenderingProjectInstances.description_en: Disassociate cloud application service instances from a project
DisassociateRenderingProjectInstances.description_zh: 云应用服务实例与项目解除关联关系

ForbidVsStream.description_en: Forbids pushing a specific stream. You can schedule a time to resume the stream
ForbidVsStream.description_zh: 禁止某条流的推送，可以预设某个时刻将流恢复

GetRenderingInstanceCommandsStatus.description_en: Queries the execution status of a control command to determine whether the command was successful and to retrieve the result string
GetRenderingInstanceCommandsStatus.description_zh: 查询控制命令的执行状态，获取命令是否执行成功、执行结果字符串等

GetRenderingInstanceStreamingInfo.description_en: Retrieves the streaming connection information for a cloud application service instance. Call this operation before establishing each streaming connection to obtain the latest connection details
GetRenderingInstanceStreamingInfo.description_zh: 获取一个云应用服务实例的流连接信息，每次流化建联前都需要调用此接口获取最新连接信息

GetRenderingProjectInstanceStateMetrics.description_en: Queries the data volume statistics for the states of project instances that meet specified conditions
GetRenderingProjectInstanceStateMetrics.description_zh: 查询一个项目满足特定条件的项目实例各状态数据量统计值

InstallCloudApp.description_en: Installs a cloud application to a specified cloud application instance. This is an asynchronous interface. To monitor the installation progress, use the ListCloudAppInstallations interface
InstallCloudApp.description_zh:
安装一个云应用到一个指定云应用实例。
属于异步接口，可通过ListCloudAppInstallations接口查询安装进度

ListCloudAppInstallations.description_en: Lists cloud application installations. The response includes the installation status of cloud application service instances and supports paged queries
ListCloudAppInstallations.description_zh: 查询云应用的安装信息列表，返回信息包括云应用服务实例的安装状态，支持分页查询

ListCloudAppPatches.description_en: Queries the list of patches for a cloud application
ListCloudAppPatches.description_zh: 查询一个云应用的Patch列表

ListCloudApps.description_en: Queries a list of cloud applications. This operation supports paged queries
ListCloudApps.description_zh: 查询云应用列表，支持分页查询

ListEdgeWorkers.description_zh: 支持分页查询负载信息

ListFilePushStatuses.description_en: Lists the push status records for a file pushed to cloud application service instances. It supports paged query
ListFilePushStatuses.description_zh: 查询文件的云应用服务实例推送状态信息列表，支持分页查询

ListFiles.description_en: Lists uploaded files. The response includes the upload status for each file and supports paged queries
ListFiles.description_zh: 查询上传的文件列表，返回内容包含文件的上传状态，支持分页查询

ListHives.description_en: Queries all cluster information by paging and supports filtering by conditions
ListHives.description_zh: 分页查询所有集群信息，支持按条件筛选

ListPublicKeys.description_en: Retrieves a list of public keys that match the specified criteria. This operation supports pagination
ListPublicKeys.description_zh: 查询满足条件的公钥信息列表，支持分页查询

ListRenderingDataPackages.description_en: Queries information about the data packets of cloud applications. Paged queries are supported
ListRenderingDataPackages.description_zh: 查询所有云应用数据包信息，支持分页查询

ListRenderingInstances.description_en: Lists basic information about cloud application service instances and supports paged queries
ListRenderingInstances.description_zh: 查询云应用服务实例基本信息列表，支持分页查询

ListRenderingProjectInstances.description_en: Retrieve a paginated list of cloud application service instances associated with a project
ListRenderingProjectInstances.description_zh: 分页查询项目关联的云应用服务实例信息列表

ListRenderingProjects.description_en: Obtain a paged list of basic information about cloud application projects for the current user
ListRenderingProjects.description_zh: 分页查询用户下的云应用服务项目基本信息列表

ListRenderingSessions.description_en: Performs a paged query for the list of cloud application service sessions based on specified conditions
ListRenderingSessions.description_zh: 分页查询指定条件下的云应用服务会话列表

ListSpecifications.description_en: Queries all cloud application service specification information. Paging is supported
ListSpecifications.description_zh: 查询所有云应用服务规格信息，支持分页查询

ModifyComfyWorkflow.description_en: Modifies the metadata of a specified workflow

ModifyDeviceAlarm.description_en: Updates the alarm status of a device

ModifyDeviceCapture.description_en: Modify the device image capture configuration

ModifyDeviceChannels.description_en: Updates the list of channels for a device

ModifyDirectory.description_en: Modifies the information of a directory

ModifyGroup.description_en: You can modify the details of a space

ModifyHiveAttribute.description_en: Updates the name or description of a specified cluster
ModifyHiveAttribute.description_zh: 用于更新指定集群的名称或描述信息

ModifyParentPlatform.description_en: Modifies the information of a parent platform

ModifyRenderingChargeType.description_en: Change the billing method for a Graphic Computing Service instance
ModifyRenderingChargeType.description_zh: 变配云渲染资源实例付费类型

ModifyRenderingInstance.description_en: Upgrades or downgrades a cloud application service instance

ModifyRenderingInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a cloud application service instance
ModifyRenderingInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 修改云应用服务实例属性

ModifyRenderingInstanceBandwidth.description_en: Updates the rate limiting bandwidth for a cloud application service instance. You can call the DescribeRenderingInstance operation to retrieve the current rate limiting value and check the status of the rate limiting update
ModifyRenderingInstanceBandwidth.description_zh:
更新一个云应用服务实例的限速带宽。
可以通过实例查询接口DescribeRenderingInstance，获取限速值与限速更新状态

MoveHiveEdgeWorkers.description_en: Moves specified workloads to a target cluster
MoveHiveEdgeWorkers.description_zh: 将指定负载移动到目标集群中

PushFile.description_en: Push a file to a specified cloud application service instance. This is an asynchronous operation. You can query the push progress using the ListFilePushStatuses operation
PushFile.description_zh:
推送一个文件到一个指定云应用服务实例。
属于异步操作，可通过ListFilePushStatuses接口查询推送进度

RebootRenderingInstance.description_en: Restarts a cloud application service instance. You can call the DescribeRenderingInstance API to monitor the restart progress
RebootRenderingInstance.description_zh:
重启一个云应用服务实例。
可通过查询接口DescribeRenderingInstance获取重启进度

RebootRenderingServer.description_en: Restarts the host of a cloud application service instance
RebootRenderingServer.description_zh: 云应用服务实例主机重启

RecoverRenderingDataPackage.description_en: Recover data to a Graphic Computing Service instance
RecoverRenderingDataPackage.description_zh: 恢复数据到云渲染实例

RefreshRenderingInstanceStreaming.description_en: Call RefreshRenderingInstanceStreaming to refresh the stream connection for a cloud application service instance
RefreshRenderingInstanceStreaming.description_zh: 调用 RefreshRenderingInstanceStreaming 刷新云应用服务实例流连接

ReleaseRenderingDataPackage.description_en: Release a cloud application service data pack
ReleaseRenderingDataPackage.description_zh: 释放云应用服务数据包

ReleaseRenderingInstance.description_en: Invoke ReleaseRenderingInstance to release a Graphic Computing Service application instance
ReleaseRenderingInstance.description_zh: 调用ReleaseRenderingInstance释放一个云应用服务实例

RenewRenderingInstance.description_en: Invoke RenewRenderingInstance to renew a cloud application service instance
RenewRenderingInstance.description_zh: 调用RenewRenderingInstance续费一个云应用服务实例

ResetRenderingInstance.description_en: Resets a cloud application service instance. You can query the DescribeRenderingInstance interface to obtain the reset progress
ResetRenderingInstance.description_zh:
重置一个云应用服务实例。
可通过查询接口DescribeRenderingInstance获取重置进度

SendRenderingInstanceCommands.description_en: Sends shell control instructions to a cloud application service instance. This operation supports both sync and asynchronous command responses. The sync scenario is not suitable for time-consuming commands. The maximum execution time cannot exceed 30 s. In an asynchronous scenario, you can call the GetRenderingInstanceCommandsStatus operation to query the execution status and result of a command
SendRenderingInstanceCommands.description_zh:
向一个云应用服务实例下发shell控制指令，支持同步/异步响应命令。
同步场景，不适用于耗时命令（最大耗时不能超过30s）。
异步场景，可通过GetRenderingInstanceCommandsStatus接口查询命令执行状态与结果

SetVsDomainCertificate.description_en: Enable or disable the certificate feature for a domain name
SetVsDomainCertificate.description_zh: 设置某域名下证书功能是否启用

StartDevice.description_en: Start stream pulling from a device. This action starts all streams on the device
StartDevice.description_zh: 启动设备拉流，会启动设备上的所有流

StartParentPlatform.description_en: Starts interactions with the parent platform, such as registration and keep-alive
StartParentPlatform.description_zh: 启动上级平台交互，如注册、保活等

StartRecordStream.description_en: Starts on-demand recording for the specified stream
StartRecordStream.description_zh: 对指定流启动按需录制

StartRenderingSession.description_en: Schedules an idle cloud application service instance for the requesting client (ClientId) and starts the service. If the requesting client (ClientId) sends another start request after a successful start and the associated session is in the SessionStartSuspended state, the session is restarted. If the session is in any other state, the session information is returned directly
StartRenderingSession.description_zh:
为请求端（ClientId）调度一个空闲云应用服务实例，并完成服务启动。
如果请求端（ClientId）启动请求发起成功后重复发起启动请求，若已关联会话处于启动暂停（SessionStartSuspended）状态，则重启会话；若会话为其他状态，则直接返回会话信息

StartTransferStream.description_en: Starts forwarding a stream to an external address
StartTransferStream.description_zh: 启动转推流到外部的地址

StopAdjust.description_en: Stops lens adjustments, such as aperture or zoom changes
StopAdjust.description_zh: 停止调节镜头，如光圈、变焦等

StopDevice.description_en: Stops stream pulling for a device. This operation terminates all streams on that device
StopDevice.description_zh: 停止设备拉流，会停止设备上的所有流

StopMove.description_en: Stops camera movement, such as panning, tilting, and zooming
StopMove.description_zh: 停止转动镜头，如水平、垂直、缩放等

StopRecordStream.description_en: Stops on-demand recording for a specified stream
StopRecordStream.description_zh: 对指定流停止按需录制

StopRenderingSession.description_en: Shut down the specified cloud application service session and revoke the associated instance resources
StopRenderingSession.description_zh: 关闭指定的云应用服务会话并回收相关实例资源

UnbindDirectory.description_en: Detach a device from a folder

UnbindParentPlatformDevice.description_en: Dissociates a device from a parent platform push configuration so that the device is no longer pushed
UnbindParentPlatformDevice.description_zh: 从上级平台推送中解绑设备，不再推送

UnbindPurchasedDevice.description_en: Unbinds a purchased device from a space
UnbindPurchasedDevice.description_zh: 从空间解绑已购买设备

UnbindTemplate.description_en: Unbind a template from a specified instance, such as a group instance or a stream
UnbindTemplate.description_zh: 解除绑定模板到指定的实例，比如：解除绑定到空间和流的实例

UninstallCloudApp.description_en: You can uninstall a specified cloud application from a specified cloud application instance. This operation is asynchronous. You can use the ListCloudAppInstallations operation to check the uninstallation progress. After successful uninstallation, the query operation no longer returns related information
UninstallCloudApp.description_zh:
卸载一个指定云应用实例上的一个指定云应用。
属于异步接口。可通过ListCloudAppInstallations接口查询卸载进度，卸载成功后，查询接口将不再输出相关内容

UpdateCloudAppInfo.description_en: Updates information for a cloud application, such as its description and tags. You can upload patch or hotfix packages and create hotfix packages for the Android cloud application marketplace. A cloud application supports up to 20 patch packages, but only one package can be in the uploading state at a time
UpdateCloudAppInfo.description_zh:
更新一个云应用的信息，如更新描述信息、更新应用标签、上传Patch等。
支持上传补丁包/热更包、支持安卓云应用市场制作热更包，一个云应用最多可上传20个补丁包、一个云应用同时只允许一个Patch是上传中状态

UpdateFileInfo.description_en: Update basic information for a file, such as its description
UpdateFileInfo.description_zh: 更新一个文件的基本信息，如描述信息

UpdateRenderingInstanceConfiguration.description_en:
This operation updates the configuration parameters of a cloud application service instance. It lets you modify various configurations of the Cloud Android system, such as prop, location, and network, to create a real device simulation.
You can retrieve the configured values for the real device simulation by calling the DescribeRenderingInstance API.
To query the configuration parameters of the real-time environment, see the DescribeRenderingInstanceConfiguration API
UpdateRenderingInstanceConfiguration.description_zh:
更新一个云应用服务实例的配置参数。支持修改云安卓系统的prop/location/network 等各种配置，构建真机仿真。
可通过实例查询接口DescribeRenderingInstance，获取已设置的真机仿真配置值。
查询实时环境的配置参数，参考接口DescribeRenderingInstanceConfiguration

UpdateRenderingInstanceSettings.description_en: Updates the settings of a cloud application service instance
UpdateRenderingInstanceSettings.description_zh: 调用 UpdateRenderingInstanceSettings 更新云应用服务实例设置

UpdateRenderingProject.description_zh: 更新一个项目的属性信息

UpdateVsPullStreamInfoConfig.description_en: Updates the configuration for stream pulling. You can modify the start and end times of origin server addresses in an existing stream pulling task
UpdateVsPullStreamInfoConfig.description_zh: 更新拉流信息，修改已经添加的拉流任务中的源站地址的开始时间和结束时间

UploadCloudApp.description_en: Upload or list a cloud application package. This is an asynchronous API. Use the ListCloudApps API to check upload progress
UploadCloudApp.description_zh:
上传/上架一个云应用包。
属于异步接口，可通过ListCloudApps接口查询上传进度

UploadFile.description_en: Uploads a file from a public URL to local or cloud storage. This is an asynchronous operation. You can call the ListFiles operation to monitor the upload progress
UploadFile.description_zh:
上传一个文件。基于外链URL（公网可下载文件）实现文件上传到本地/云存储。
属于异步操作，可通过ListFiles接口查询上传进度

UploadPublicKey.description_zh: 上传一个新的公钥信息
